product_name: Infinix GT 30 Pro 5G+ (Dark Flare, 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage) | MediaTek D8350 Ultimate | 120FPS BGMI Gaming | Gaming Triggers | 1.5 Million+ AnTuTu | Infinix AI
description: 120FPS BGMI GAMING: The GT 30 Pro is certified by Krafton for 120 FPS gaming on BGMI, offering smoother visuals, faster touch response, and improved accuracy—ideal for competitive, fast-paced gameplay. SUPERIOR PROCESSOR: The GT 30 Pro, powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8350 ULTIMATE and HyperEngine Adaptive Gaming Technology, delivers fast performance, smooth gaming, and efficient multitasking. GAMING TRIGGERS: GT Shoulder Triggers offer console-like input for mobile gaming, reducing screen clutter and enhancing control. They’re also customizable for quick access to other functions, boosting overall usability. GAMING DESIGN: The GT 30 Pro features the Cyber Mecha 2.0 design, blending geometric precision with bold style tailored for gamers. It comes in two variants: Dark Flare with aggressive RGB lighting, and Blade White with a minimal white LED look. Customizable LED lights on the back enhance the experience for scenarios like charging and music. OPTIMIZIED SOFTWARE: XBoost AI offers advanced gaming optimization with Esports Mode, which blocks distractions and boosts performance. It also features Network Enhancement for smoother connectivity and Performance Modes to manage resources efficiently without affecting gameplay.
